snippet.title: Run from the Feds 1.1 Official Announcement Trailer | Run from the Feds - C&K Games
snippet.description:
Enjoy a new festive theming on each official non-secret level and two new event exclusive levels during the new Fedmas and Federalween events!

Fedmas will take place every year from December First to January Seventh!
Federalween will take place every year from October First to October Thirty-First!

Game Page: https://gamejolt.com/games/Run-from-the-feds/886705
C&K Games Discord Server: https://discord.gg/6v6Ag3E8gf
